titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, Irish Times
mainText: An Irish citizen was sentenced to 14 years in prison for killing a U.S. tourist in Hungary.
Ebola death toll in Congo exceeds 600, with suspected new cases reported in previously unaffected provinces.

titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, BBC News
mainText: At least 28 people died in a shoe factory fire in China, according to state media.
President Trump stated in a meeting with President Zelenskyy that the U.S. will allow Patriot missiles to be manufactured overseas.
Iran plans to bury Ayatollah Ali Khamenei following week-long funeral ceremonies.
